text:
Based on all the positive reviews we thought we were going to pick up a real treat for dinner. Boy, were we wrong!

Firstly, we are less than 10 minutes from this restaurant. We left immediately after placing the order; they brought it to us in our car (props for proper social distancing & sanitary procedures); and arrived home in the same amount of time. Well, the food ranged from barely warm, to stone cold. 

Tempura Calamari -- 10 small cold breaded rings. $7.95

Fresh Roll - almost all lettuce with some rice vermicelli. Possibly some tofu. Anything else in the description was MIA. 2@ $6.95

Pad Thai with Chicken & Shrimp. The noodles were all stuck together with a sauce that basically tasted like ketchup. A small amount of dry chewy chicken & shrimp. The dish was so unappetizing that we ate a few mouthfuls and tossed the rest. $15.95

Amazing Pad Eggplant. Totally mushy & tasteless. It followed the Pad Thai into the garbage. $13.95.

The portions were minuscule. Frankly, it looked like they had smaller to go containers and just put in enough to fill them. I wonder if their eat in portions are this tiny?

BTW, the total was $48.61!
Favorite Hibachi spot in town. They're sushi is good but not nearly as good as the hibachi. Staff is usually very helpful and give good sized portions. Can't beat it!

I thought the point of curbside pick up was to avoid long wait times in the drive through. So while I waited 27 minutes for my two sandwiches the drive through had car after car go through within 5 minutes

Came here with family for our first meal of the year 2020 and we were all in good spirits when we walked in. Made reservations and didn't wait long to be seated. We came in to the resteraunt at 3:30 but didn't leave until after 6pm because of the super slow service. Had to ask for things multiple times, my soup took over an hour to come out and appetizers came out after our main meal. No water refills, no changing grills in between, no napkins etc. towards the end when they didn't bring out my dessert I just asked for the check. Then their machine wasn't working or something because they swiped my card multiple times and locked my account and my sisters . Then when we asked for the manager (Amy)  no one came. I've been to other locations for this resteraunt never had such a bad experience such as this ever. You would think for over 200 dollars worth of food we would get atlwaR some sort or decent service.

We had a very unsettling experience here last night. I've been here a few times, and my friend and her husband come here a lot so let me say that this is one of her favorite spots. She made a reservation LAST week for 3 of us for a girls' night, and requested an outside table for 3 on the roofed patio next to the outside wall. Unfortunately, one friend cancelled at the last moment. We informed the hostess. She then she spoke to another woman and they both seemed perplexed as to what to do with us. We waited too long (no one else was waiting) for a table which we had reserved a week before. When they finally seated us, they took us to an very damp area where no one else was sitting - there was a narrow roof, but the sides were uncovered and it had been raining all day and was still raining lightly with a light breeze - the tables had to be dried and that didn't stop them from getting wet again. The waitress informed us that we could not move our table because of COVID (how can you not move a table to the center when no one else is seated in the area???) so we moved it ourselves closer to the center  - TWICE. When the hostess came over with the waitress, my friend explained to her that we were getting wet and had reserved a table on the porch. She walked away, gave my friend a roll-of-the-eye look, and threw up her hands. Cocktails here are always excellent, but my food last night was just okay. I had a small piece of Mahi, some rice mix with it - nothing amazing. Not sure how

When you're at the beach you think of seafood but there are times when just need a steak. There are not a lot of options...some like Watercolors or the Beachcomber but the very best is Blinkers.
I had an excellent steak with tasty side dishes and excellent bread.
Service is top notch too. My server Adam really knew the menu and wine...and I'm a wine snob! His recommendations were excellent and he was attentive and sincerely interested in making sure I had a great dining experience. I'll be back!

We had our first pizza here today and loved the whole experience. It's absolutely our favorite pizza now. And we were delighted we could sit inside and enjoy our meal there. I will shout my praises all over the place about Longboards.

First time at this location, and at this restaurant in general. I'm unimpressed, went here with my siblings and my mother expecting good service. The waiter was nice and everything, but her ability to get our stuff was less than nice. We waited a few minutes to get our drinks, which wasn't bad, but then we ordered. It took the average time for our food to get out. I got my food, without one of my sides which was of fries. She asks if everything was good, as if she couldn't notice my plate without any fries. I said, "didn't I have a side of fries?" And she said, "I told them to make them, I'll be right back" and she went about her way. She then went out to the patio, which is the kitchen in the patio? No. So it showed how her priority to get me my food was set at. We also noticed that my mothers soup was missing too. It took her a while to start on my fries and my mothers soup. She also lacked on getting our refills. Overall, I think that this was terrible, and we won't be back. I'm not meaning to be rash about this, I'm just trying to explain my experience and how it turned out bad.

Went here knowing that it was a tap house did not know it was a chain "tap house" not going back. Husband had a turkey club sandwich, meat looked like it might have come from a can or at least a bag of shredded meat. I had the Margaritas flatbread pizza. Basil was tasteless and sauce was over salted. Husband had one of their names brand stouts that was watered down.
It's good italian restaurant been there for years and years decor is nice and food is good service good too

This place is awesome! Was recommended to hit this spot, and GLAD I did. Food is amazing, even though there is a little wait since the food is made from scratch but the wait is worth it. If you are in town you should definitely eat here!

We weren't crazy hungry so we came to Tupelo Honey for a few appetizers on NYE. It was still early but they had a 2 hour wait, so we sat at the bar. We decided on the Biscuits for a Cause, Crispy Brussels, and Famous Fried Green Tomatoes.

The biscuits are HUGE - so big we probably could have only ordered one other appetizer because they were so filling. I enjoyed the whipped butter and blueberry jam spread, but I think it would be better if the jam was blended a little more. There were several full blueberries in the jam, which made it difficult to scoop onto the knife and then spread evenly on the biscuits. 

The Crispy Brussels had great flavor. I only had a couple of bites of the Fried Green Tomatoes, but my husband said they weren't his favorite. He thought the breading was too thick and wasn't crazy about the red pepper sauce.

If you order the Grill Cheese tell them to hold the HAIR...
Im no health inspector but thought you had to wear hairnets while handling food...
All other times we came here we had good food and good service but after this time we will not be coming back...

Fist off kudos for advertising on Yelp. Without that I wouldn't have ever discovered this hidden gem. I don't like to hand out 5 stars easily but this is one that is required. 

About the meal...I ordered the brisket platter that came with two sides. Pictured is the deep fried corn on the cob. A lot of places offer this but it's not the same. This is on another level!!! Slathered in butter and topped with seasoned salt. It's incredible! Second side was seasoned fries which were seasoned well. The brisket was Smokey and terrific. The sauce was incredible. I tried the sweet and the heat. The heat has serious kick and I really enjoyed it. We also tried the deep fried pickles which were incredible. They've found a regular in me. Must tey

Open and spacious and clean. Social distancing followed. Ordered our specialty coffee and an iced tea. Both were very good. Very friendly staff. We would return. Have been meaning to stop in here for quite awhile. The parking is always the issue in this area. Park in the parking garage and walk out the North entrance. Cross over the bike path and you are there.

They just reopened recently and I arrived yesterday about 8am and there was noone handing out masks as i walked in but when I left there was. I bought chips and I looked around to see if there was sanitizer inside the cage for him to use as there was several people in line and I  didn't see any inside and there was none outside for me to use. I was playing a table game upstairs in a large room and I went to get a soda and the machine has a touch screen for your fingertips but there is no sanitizer anywhere nearby. The closest one is by the chip window and it has been broken for at least 2 days even though i brought it to managements attention the day prior. I was walking out down stairs and washed my hands and they have a hot air blower and the WHO says thats not as effective at killing germs as rubbing your hands with paper towels. I will say the employees were skilled at their job and very friendly. 5 stars for the dealers but 2 for management.

Always an excellent experience...great food and service....I have never been disappointed here. Don't pass the cheesy bruschetta...the best in town! Mimosas made with fresh squeezed OJ...yummy! Liege waffles were very sweet. Turkey pesto sandwich delicious.

Return to great full gardens for the first time since the quarantine. They are following social distancing guidelines. We enjoyed a chicken sandwich BLT a and the baby had a huge plate of chicken broccoli and rice. Service was great the restaurant was very quiet. Had seating inside and out.
Beautiful spot in downtown St Pete. The food was delicious but the service was pretty mediocre. I plan on returning.
The food was good, service was lacking.  They sat five of us at threes little patio tables that weren't even big enough for two. Waitress was not attentive.  Won't be back.

Usually love Cantwell's as far as food quality and service goes, but today I saw the cook wrap my burrito without gloves. Why didn't I say anything at the time? I don't know--I'm a risk taker. But with everything going on, come on...

Classy interior with nice view of the inland waterway. Pricey but great service. Life's a Beach and nutty coconut margaritas were spectacular. What is your selection was good and we enjoyed them. The school of fish is a nice combination of grouper cake, mediocre salmon and the tuna teriyaki was too heavy on the sauce. The mussels were in a very different sauce which may not be good for all. and the arugula and beet salad . The  hog snapper was fine.

Super awesome pizza place that never disappoints.  Our go to spot ALWAYS. The cheesesteaks don't disappoint nor do the salads, sandwiches or pizza.  Owner is so accommodating and nice as well as the rest of the staff. Totally recommend!!!!! My daughter and I love Enzo's and hope they always stay a part of our neighborhood
Clean place, friendly staff, I just like my bread baked longer should be golden brown not off white, meat quality was excellent just not happy with the bread - but service good and fair price

Best place to get donuts in this city!!! They rotate their donuts weekly to switch things up, which is why I follow their donut updates on Instagram, haha. I personally love getting their donuts with filling, though have never been disappointed by any of their options. My favorite is the cannoli donut, but its always a mystery of when it will make its way back there. They also have really great sliders, coffee, and sandwiches. Located in a convenient spot, this place makes for a popular destination while strolling on Magazine Street. Parking can get a bit difficult as the lot next door is no longer free, but I have never had any issue finding a spot on one of the neighboring side streets.
Worth the wait time if there is one. Incredible menu, great drinks and good service. The outdoor patio is lovely as well.

Delicious food. Attentive staff. Very helpful and willing to answer any questions we had about the menu. When I went we were the only people there until about halfway through our meal. 

I loved that my food came to my table via a little train. Absolutely adorable. 

Will definitely be coming back.

Just no.... Half star. Whoever opened this place read online that Chicago has good pizza and named it based on that. Have y'all heard of garlic? Pizza was nasty, Italian beef tastes like salty sweat water. Believe it or not best thing on the menu is cold ass fries or the veggie spring rolls. We ordered through uber eats which stated 10-25 minutes, over an hour and a half later their own pizza delivery driver shows up and says "here ya go it's cold as shit" and walks away.

I pizza never showed up! Called after an hour and they said don't worry he'll be there any minute. Waited another 15 and the store was closed.  
I'm hungry!
Never a bad experience at Jockamo's. There cheese Louise pizza is absolutely amazing. I have to get it anytime I'm in town.

I am very close to calling it quits to this place. I was trying to help their business by ordering boba every week for pick up but the customer service isn't great. They don't have boba avail and when they do it's old boba. How do I know, because I'm a boba snob and I know when my boba was a few days old. They would tell me my drink would be ready in 10 mins and when I get there I'm waiting 20 minutes?!

Outside of refusing dine in service the food was below average by the time it was unboxed.
Soggy tortillas, cold chips, queso with oatmeal like consistency & most importantly very scant portions of protein.

Would avoid until they reopen for service and you can verify the quality of food
Fantastic Thai food and superb service. Very reasonable lunch prices as well. Will definitely return when back in town.

*pre covid review*

Last summer while on vacation in Philly we discovered this adorable cafe and decided we had to check it out. When we arrived we were seated right away at the way back of the building. After sitting down we quickly noticed that it was hot inside the restaurant. Our server brought over menus and apologized for the heat stating that the air conditioning in that particular room was not working. When she left to get our drinks we began talking about how weird it was that they sat us in this room without air conditioning when we passed several seating areas in other rooms that weren't full. It was kind of annoying to not understand the logic behind it and to spend our meal being hot but we didn't push it any further. 

As for the food we ordered deviled eggs for the table and I got the biscuit and gravy skillet. The food was amazing which is why I kept the review at 4 stars even after the air conditioning fiasco. The deviled eggs came with 6 total 3 different kinds, all unique and all delicious. They were very elevated and sophisticated versions of standard deviled eggs. This is what I wish deviled eggs were all the time!

The biscuit and gravy skillet was also very dangerously delicious. We all kind of shared it and everyone took bites because it was so rich and flavorful. We had a big day ahead of us and didn't want to over eat. I really did want to eat the whole thing by myself. 

Overall I would recommend coming here. I hope if you do they have the air condi

Amazing. Just, amazing. 

PIZZA REVIEW ONLY!!

My wife and I have just moved to the St. Louis area. We're stuck in a hotel until our closing and are stuck ordering take out from everywhere. 

We've been here twice to grab some pizzas and they've been great both times. I get the New York style crust, my wife gets the thin crust. 

The crust on the New York style is nice and crispy on the bottom and chewy overall. The thin crust is as it should be, thin, but holds together and doesn't fall apart. 

The ingredients have been fresh both times. 

I would post a few pictures but I shoved the pizza in my face too quick and before I thought of it it was mostly gone and my hands were covered with sauce and toppings goop. 

Next time. 

Tell 'em Steve sent you! (They won't know who that is it what you're talking about but it might be funny, and if you're lucky maybe that will mean something to them and you'll get some sort of discount. Good luck!)

This was by far the best and freshest pizza I have had in America. They had homemade sauce and pasta as well. I purchased some to take back home with me. The owner gave my son a small pasta just for him. She was passionate about her food and it shows. She makes everything there. She told next week her sauce will be in whole foods and can get it on Amazon  I hope to he able to go back again if in the ybor area again.

Great place . We sat outside and it was delicious. Derrick was our server and was so helpful and friendly. Gumbo and French onion soup are second to none in the city which is saying a lot. Will be back

Consistently good quality food served up quickly. I love trying out the new offerings and I'm rarely disappointed. From the Coastal Med Bowl to the salads to the kabobs, I almost always leave satisfied. Even the burgers are delicious!
Have eaten here with my family three times now. Very satisfying experience with the food and service each time. Good eats!!

Went to the McDonalds on Mae Anne in Reno, waited 30 minutes in the drive through and the food was soooo bad. Know it's McDonalds so expectations weren't too high. Quarter pounder deluxe had super wilted lettuce and a weird extra piece of meat on it. Kid cheeseburger meal with out mustard had a ton of mustard on it and fries were soggy and cold. Needless to say the whole pile went into the trash uneaten. Won't do that again.  Have tried this McDonald's several times and always get something's wrong or even really gross. Won't be doing that again.
Great seafood! Loved the service! Yelp reviews were absolutely right! So happy we chose to go here!
From San Diego and  growing up with various Taco shops Oscar's food brings home to Me.

Please don't waste your time or your money. I ordered delivery and it took an hour and a half to get my food. Then to my extreme disappointment the food wasn't good. The samosas tastes like they were fried in old oil and maybe they were par fried, and then fried completely as they are ordered. I don't know but they were not good. I got chicken and lamb over rice, the lamb was tough and over cooked, the chicken wasn't season and the onion and bell peppers were weird. My daughter got chicken over rice. If we were not quarantined, it would have been cheaper and better to go to halal truck, and know for sure you're getting something that taste good and is worth the price, as opposed to spending over $30 for food that ended up in the trash!!

This is by far my favorite place for Mexican food!  This place looks very sketchy but it is well worth giving it a try.  The meats are amazing!  Best Horchata I have ever had.  Free chips and salsa.  I plan to come here very often!

I love Indian food and have been to many places...this place by far is the worst. Yeah it's not so costly but the portions/quality/flavor/service was horrible! I would not recommend this location to anyone! Most of my food was taken home as left overs and I couldn't even bring myself to eat it again.

Nice open atmosphere. Cool, friendly service. 
Most of all the food was phenomenal. Freshly made Lan Zhou noodles, house made chili sauce (delicious) refreshing slushes (not made with syrup) an array of mushrooms to offer, & a great selection of any meat/protein you would want. 
I highly recommend if you are looking for an authentic noodle experience.

Nice hidden gem right here in South Jersey. The food was very fresh and tasty. We ordered the chicken fajitas and the fajita mix which comes with steak, chicken and shrimp. We also had the chips and salsa which were very good as well. What made our experience even better was our server Steve. He was very polite and made us feel at home. So do yourself a favor and grab a seat and enjoy this delicious food. I promise you will not be disappointed.

I've been to Hot Tin several times over the last few months but never got around to writing a review. The things that keep us coming back are the delicious drinks and the fantastic view. Yesterday I got the Champagne Safari and my boyfriend got the Skyliner. Both drinks were nice and refreshing after what turned out to be a very warm day walking around the city. Mine was a twist on a pimm's cup which is one of my go to drinks. We'll definitely be going back for more drinks and more beautiful skyline views.

India Garden is the nicest Indian buffet in town. Not only is it good, it's cheap! I would eat there all the time for lunch but then none of my clothes would fit. Regular naan and deep fried naan. There is always a good variety in the buffet with chicken makhani being the star. I've also been for dinner with family and had the same excellent food and attentive service. Highly recommend for newbies to Indian food. The restaurant is owned by a nice family that you'll see there everyday!

After many weeks of anticipation, we finally made it over to the new location for lunch this Saturday. I'm disappointed to say it was not a positive experience. Two stars is generous. One for decor. One because it appears clean. Unfortunately the dining experience itself wasn't even kinda good. 

The people in front of us got the last table, so we landed at the bar. No biggie. Except it became immediately obvious that the bartender wasn't interested in providing service so much as he was interested in just going through the motions. Zero hustle in this guy. Getting anything in a timely manner was like pulling teeth. Nothing was anticipated; I had to request literally everything (straw, app plates, another beer, chips, hot sauce, everything). Didn't help that we witnessed the bartender and other staff taking shots and then continuously sipping on margaritas throughout our meal. 

As bad as the service was, the food was even worse. We ordered the Cardinal Queso to start but were out of chips by the time the queso arrived (it comes without chips). So, we had no way to eat it. The woman who'd brought the queso said she'd be right back with chips. She wasn't. Five full minutes passed before we were able to catch the bartender's attention and get more chips. Wasn't worth the wait. The queso turned out to be thin and watery. Literally so soupy it wouldn't even stick to chips, dripped right off. Gross. 

My husband's "Mission style" burrito was clearly made by somebody who has never

This place is an absolute hidden gem in a strip mall close to my hotel. The cheesesteak was amazing as are the sandwiches that are fresh cut meat.  Portions are huge.  Large cheesesteak can feed two grown men. Steak was excellent and the rolls were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.  I may not be a native Philly guy, but i've had Pat's and Jim's and Geno's, this is just as good if not better.  Service was also friendly and fast!  Highly recommend.
This was our first visit to Darfons. There were seven family members and everyone was pleased with service and food.

I think I have found my new favorite sushi spot on the Main Line!

My regular sushi spot closed at the height of the pandemic so I had to find another restaurant to satisfy my sushi cravings. Sushi Nami was open and I was delighted with my order.

My go-to sushi order is a Philadelphia Roll and a Spicy Tuna Roll. Sushi Nami's sushi rolls are big and full of fresh ingredients. They do not skimp on filling the rolls. 

It's easy to place pickup orders online on their website. Their servers who help you check out at the restaurant are always friendly. Can't wait for my next Sushi Nami order!

Zero stars.  As I was eating my chicken tikka Masala I realized there was a roach in it. I literally threw up. Unacceptable. How do you not inspect the food you send out to your customers?. NEVER AGAIN.

Yummy House has really grown over the years. It went from a single Cantonese restaurant on Waters to now a major Chinese restaurant in the Tampa area with locations in Tampa, Orlando, Sarasota, Gainesville, and Ocala. This location off of Hillsborough Avenue would probably be considered their flagship location. In terms of decor, this place is quite nice. It has the nice dark floors, ample amounts of dining room space where you don't feel like you're cramped together with other diners, and pretty clean bathrooms. The larger dining room also means that this place is a decent location to host larger dinners or lunches and the push cart dim sum works well here because there is actually room to maneuver the carts around. However, when I went this time, I was rather disappointed by the quality of the food. It almost feel like the standards have slipped a bit and I hope it's something that they can correct soon. The dim sum that came to my table were all rather lukewarm, like they've been sitting around for some time. Furthermore, some of the steamed dishes like the shrimp dumplings or shark fin dumplings were stuck to the bottom of the dim sum container such that when you went to grab it with your chopsticks, the dumpling wrapper would tear and half of the contents within the dumpling would fall out. The Salt and Pepper Calamari, which is one of their signature dishes, tasted on the sweeter side. It didn't taste like salt and pepper anymore and more like someone had sprinkled suga
Service on point, knots stole the show. It's my second visit I'm full and still want more

Location, location, location.  What a great spot.  Tables right on the sand are great.  Although the patio is not bad either.  There is free parking available in front and to the left of the restaurant.  Also plenty of pay parking that's not expensive if the free spaces are full.  If it's crowded, we take a walk along the beach.  Happy friendly staff.  Very attentive servers.  The fare is exactly what you would expect for a beach side restaurant and they do a really good job at it.  We go multiple times when we are in town.  They are taking Covid seriously.  I felt very safe eating here.

This restaurant is excellent. We have come twice and both times, the BBQ was really good. We have had turkey, pulled pork, and brisket. All their meats have been of high quality and delicious --nice smoky flavor. They have a nice patio for eating and relaxing. The employees are friendly and the prices are very reasonable. We will return as this is some of the best BBQ we have had.

This is real Italian food, the food is so delicious... I give the food 5 Stars... The atmosphere I give a 2, I think some Italian music or any back ground music or noise would be great... The wife is very nice and you can tell she wants to provide good service... The husband often seems grumpy... we have been a few times. The last time we had a Groupon and he seemed annoyed by it. I don't understand really. It's just $10 off the check and they are the ones who advertise their business threw Groupon. So I would I assume he would be happy about business. But I guess not. Anyway if you go for the food try the manicotti or Ravioli. The lobster, crab and truffle  Ravioli good.

The quality isn't there. We went a few weeks back when they had a grand opening event where you get to do hotpot and kbbq for the price of one and was glad that we did both. Because honestly, I would have been even more disappointed than I was. 

For kbbq, the meat quality was not good. A lot of the meat we grilled became pretty tough after cooked. And the marinaded meat just didn't penetrate the meat enough so it lacked flavor. But there is a sauce bar, you might say? Well why put marinaded meat on the menu if I have to douse in a sauce I have to make? 

Your staple grilling veggies (lettuces, onion, mushrooms, etc) are at the self-serve bars which was pretty annoying to get because the spacing between the tables are pretty tight. And they're mainly booths so if you sit on the inside, then everyone has to get up just to let you out. 

Moving onto the hotpot, I gotta say the soup is pretty darn good. I got  the pickled cabbage base and I really enjoyed it. Tart and refreshing. The things that get cooked in the hotpot, not so much. Their thinly sliced meats are surely thin because it's breaks into tiny pieces when you try to pick it up and place it in your pot. 

The service we got was really nice and attentive. The girl serving us was definitely new but was still helpful. Two stars because it has the potential to become better and the service was decent. 

TLDR; Lack quality ingredients, tight space, decent service.

While roaming around Bourbon looking for new ways to intoxicate yourself, occasionally you may want a meal; or at least something that's not liquid to sustain you.  Crescent City Pizza is a good place to do just that.  I had a slice of pepperoni and my girlfriend had the BBQ pork with the apples on it and we both got a beer (about half the taps were out though because so many of you heathens went in there and drank it all).

The pepperoni was good, way better than the pizza I had at Emeril's joint down the street, but it was suuuuper greasy.  But that's pretty much what you sign up for in these types of situations, so no biggie on my end.

My girlfriend said that the BBQ pork was good, but the apple slices would have been better if they were portioned smaller.

All in all, a good place and one that I'm likely to return to in a drunken stupor the next time I stumble by.

Haven't visited in person but ordered delivery. The wraps and sandwiches were delicious! Not pictured below but the falafel had a good consistency (not too dry or overly crunchy). The dolmades were tasty and came in good portions for sharing. The portion sizes were very fair and great for a lunch meal.

Every dish I've had is so good, wonderfully fresh and flavorful!  I'm planning on making a meal of the appetizer sampler made of hummus, tzatziki and feta spread with pita. Each bite makes you say yum! 
There's outdoor seating and social distancing awareness.
The meal kits are an excellent idea. Great Mediterranean cuisine. Splendid staff and exceptional clean restaurant.

Amazing! From out of town and ordered butter chicken, garlic naan and the chickpea masala. Enough for 3 people with left overs and the flavor was everything we were craving. Easy pick up and everything was clean. Looking forward to trying it when everything is open.

I was a bit hesitant about trying out Great Full Gardens in Sparks as I've had less than stellar experiences with the near Smith's in south Reno. Hesitant no more. The service was great, the food (I had a pastrami reuben and my wife had the BLTA) was excellent and it came out much, much faster than their other restaurant even though it was packed. 
So many choices, whether you are vegan, vegetarian, or just want some good food. Loved the blue cheese vinaigrette that I had with the green salad side. This may become my go to place when coming to Legends. Am definitely going to go back.

My husband and I order from this restaurant a lot. I am very impressed with the food. The jerk chicken and plantains are very good. I like their Mac and cheese and stewed chicken as well. Coconut breeze is a sweet find. I appreciate there food portions as well as the quality of the food.

Doesn't look like much on the outside but this place is a gem. The food quality is excellent and the customer service is phenomenal. They are really attentive and friendly. They are constantly asking if you need a refill on your drink and as soon as you're  done with a dish they come by to scoop it up. The lunch specials Monday-Friday 11:30-3:30 has amazing prices. The restaurant is closed for and hour 3:30-4:30 then they open back up for dinner. Sushi is ALWAYS 50% off and they have a great selection. The habachi meals always have a nice flavor and their ginger dressing for the salad is one of the best I've had compared to similar places. The miso soup also has a nice light flavor. I find myself craving thes establishments food often.

I ordered the basic biscuit south of chicken. Try to use one. First half of my biscuits I was saying well there are no condiments is Roy it's no good. The second half I started appreciating the biscuit melting with the chicken. So it felt less dry. It was just the chicken and this week. No mustard no catch up no nothing. So it was good. I ate outside and the pieces that dropped from my sandwich by 20 birds just waiting on the tree outside to come and eat the food coming out of my sandwich. Also waiting outside I saw people take a picture of the building across the street so I took a picture of that building and then posted it here. So easy to miss art when you are eating and hungry. Hunger should not cancel sight.
Great Fried Chicken... and Gluten free!  You cannot taste any difference with them using gluten free flour!

Worst service i had in a long time, the server showed no interest in serving us, he actually told us he couldn't take our order because he had a large table he needed to deal with first.  My wife asked for a soup another server said was available, when we asked for the soup our server said she lied and they didn't have that soup. So we ordered another soup, he brought out a tiny portion and told us they did t have enough, then 5 mins later he brings out a full bowl of the soup, not sure what that was about. The food was good that i will say like really really good, but I didn't feel hospitality at all.  Also the bus boy knocked over our drink as he was bringing our food , clearly an accident and he offered to make another drink but at that point we were turned off tremendously.  Bill came, the drink was on it, we told our server that our drink was spilled he then took it off of our bill, however that should've been taken off immediately. I love crabby bills, 1st time we ever felt this way, hopefully we will have better service next time!! Or we won't be coming back. Peace!

I went on Saturday (8/17/19) and had a delicious dinner. I tried their sampler 2 Spring roll, 2 Crab Rangoon, 2 Deep-Fried Prawns, 2 Crispy Coconut Milk Balls. No disappointment there. The egg drop and wonton soup come in giant bowls so if you order you can share and the server brings smaller bowls for everyone. I had the honey chicken which was very good. Portion sizes are big. It was a most enjoyable dinner.
Love this place! The food is consistently good and it has a great atmosphere. Wait staff are always friendly.

Grabbed an Americano on a snowy day when I was surprised they were still open. Workers invited me in from cold while I waited. Got some ice cream off the recommendation for the girlfriend after a Valentine's Day dinner. She loved it.

Fresh ingredients translate to spectacular food! Their cheese pizza is best in the area, HANDS DOWN! It was cooked to perfection. Their cannolis are amazing.. the shell did not get soggy but lasted to the next day and tasted just as great with the sweet and tasty cannoli cream. Their Alfredo sauce is excellent too! I've only done takeout, but their quality is consistent and great. Definitely hope to dine-in soon after the pandemic passes.

I think it's overpriced for the quality of food . You're paying for location and atmosphere .  I've been several times and I've yet to have a memorable meal but always have a memorable time.  Today I had the stack which is a tomato eggplant napoleonsalad . I've had it before and I'm always underwhelmed but they don't have many lighter options on menu. 
I will say I've had the calamari and it is one of the best I've had .  
Han is the best barber in town !

Very good Chinese food for an Uber take out order. 

Chicken lomein was great!

The Eggroll was also nice. Highly suggest this spot if you want a nice option for Uber eats lunch or dinner. 

Surprised it wasn't rated higher. Give credit wear it's fo people! :) try it, it's tasteyyyyy

1016 Woodland Street is where you can find this gem; it is nestled between 3Crow and Five Points Pizza in the heart of East Nashville's diverse night life district. Disclaimer: I stuck to a liquid diet of the cider beer, Bold Rock; I did not partake in their food menu. Due to this, I have attached photos of their full menu. My friend ordered the Gumbo, Deviled Eggs, and coupled these items with several Bloody Mary's. Her gumbo was to her liking, the Bloody Mary's were "perf", but the eggs were returned. My opinion: TRY IT OUT. Let us know your experience!
Delicious breakfast! Gluten free bread was better than most. Good size portions. Super friendly staff and fast service. Love it!
I just found this little nugget in my backyard.  The sandwiches are delicious and they are helping our community by feeding breakfast to those in need.

Rice was not even close to being cooked completely. Very hard bite. It was a very busy Sunday for our family, and we didn't have time to food shop, this was a super disappointing dinner. 
I don't think we'll be back, despite living close by.

I took this tour because I guess you're supposed to.  It was disappointing, but I would have been more disappointed if I didn't do it.  The tour is about 2 hours long with a meal although there is an option to go without - which I did.  The tour was about 1.5 hours too long.  I would have preferred to just go to the bridge and back.  The jazz music was fun to have in the background.  We did the night tour, so once you pull away from the city, you basically see nothing, although I'm not certain how much there is to see.  They need to do something to keep the history, but bring the entertainment (not the music) to 2020.  Maybe an app where you can self educate on your phone about the boat's and New Orlean's history.  I can now say that I did it and  you probably will as a tourist thing to do, but would not really recommend it to anyone.
Best pizza in StL! Simple, vegetarian and Vegan, fresh, flavorful, thin, and cooked well. Great staff and prices. Take all my money!
First time here and we had a phenomenal experience. Great food, atmosphere and service. Very reasonable to boot. If you haven't been here yet- make plans to go. We will definitely be back!

Great place to go for anyone who loves wine or wants to taste different wines. Most people were drinking wine flights, my group included. It was a great way to try four types of red or white wine. However, you can purchase by the glass or bottle. The staff was very friendly and helpful with choosing wines. Great selections, as well as great food choices. The cheese board is obviously the right choice. The bleu cheese was so delicious! Great ambience inside, but if the weather is nice, they open the window just off the sidewalk. Would definitely recommend and come back!
This is absolutely the best chinese restaurant in Santa Barbara. The food is prepared from very fresh ingredients and carefully spiced. The servers are friendly and attentive.
Great Italian food. Wife had the gnocchi and I got the tuna special (both were great). Likely going to be bringing my parents when they come to town next.

The food was excellent our server Terry was on point. He was very personable and paid attention to all the important details. This is my 2nd visit in the past couple of weeks and will definitely be back. Don't forget to ask for Terry.

We ordered takeout on a whim and every single thing was OUTSTANDING! The flavors are so fresh. We ordered the crab rangoon, egg rolls, basil and garlic fried rice with chicken and bubble tea - pretty basic standards, but the dishes were anything but basic. Given the quality or what we ordered, we're already looking forward to trying more. We've decided this is our new standby.
Made the reservation for our anniversary.   Dinner and dessert was wonderful.   Perfect place to celebrate!

Bakersfield is your typical trendy taco/Mexican food spot. The avocado is always fresh in the guacamole, but do wish the tortillas for the tacos didn't fall apart so easily. They have recently expanded their menu and added more variety. The margaritas had a lot of ice and were not filled all the way.

The restaurant is located right off of Edenborn Ave., around the corner from the Lakeside mall. It was a decent sized restaurant with plenty of parking for peak lunch rush times. It has a modest / plain look on the outside and becomes more Vietnamese-esque when you walk in.

I am a decent fan of Pho restaurants and this one was very good. The staff was very nice and pleasant to talk to. They have paper menus and physical menus and seem to be very sanitary when you walk in. They have a dine in bar, tables and booths and you can pick and choose where you want to eat.

The decorations were nice upon the eyes and it had a very comfortable setting. The restaurant is around the corner from the Lakeside mall and will take you two streets away from the action but it is a nice comfortable walk from there. 

The food was good and felt freshly made. You get the options to use European utensils or you can take the risk and use chop sticks. I ordered the Pho Nam (I am usually a pho ga / chicken kind of person) and I did not regret my decision. The food was fantastic and tasted great. It only cost me $9 for the meal and it was a very good portion for its cost.

I would highly recommend it. It was a good experience and the food was amazing. I went while they were rushing and they still make it a comfortable setting. All the employees wore mask and they stayed just far enough away from you to make you comfortable. 

Food- A
Location- C
Convenience - B
Romantic / theme setting - A

The restaurant was full, so we opted to sit at the bar rather than wait.  Our server was friendly and our service was fast.  I at the avocado toast while my husband had the classic breakfast.  They were both good, but the French toast was the star of the show.  We had the coconut cream stuffed French toast.  It was filled with creamy coconut, topped with a grilled pineapple and sugared macadamia nuts.  It was huge and one serving was more than enough for us to share.  We would for sure go back!

Outstanding food.   The Mac-n-Cheese with Hot Chicken on top was an Oscar winning performance.  To add insult I ordered the Hot Chicken Pizza...legitimately the finest ever.  That pizza is genius.  So many elements to
cover but it came down to something so simple and offen overlooked...they season the finished pie with a  salt based powder that covers even the crust.  Crust needs salt and these wizards figured it out. 

It's embarrassing reading some of the
nimwit poor reviews  of this fine place.   Run do not walk and enjoy a  fabulous meal.

*Clean
*Friendly Service 
*yummy food 
*they have almond milk 

Really cute place everyone was really friendly and patient. tried a couple of donuts and some avocado toast. the food was yummy and their iced matcha latte is good. i'll definitely be back again to try out more of their food. also they do have almond milk which is a plus for me.

Zagol Ethiopian Restaurant has wonderful food and great service. The dishes are so flavorful and tasty and their unique food can't be experienced any where else in Reno. Right when you walk into the door your greeted with the strong smell of herbs and spices, which you can experience when eating the food. I loved everything about it and I would go there again and again.

Best experience i ever had at a restaurant especially during the pandemic. I came here for a birthday dinner with my two friends and her mother we were seated outside in front of the restaurant. social distance was very much enforced.  everyone wore a mask and the service was awesome. Our server was Gregoria and she was just the sweetest. she cater to all of our needs and constantly checked up on us and made sure that we had everything we needed for a great experience. all of our food came out great and she made sure that my friends birthday was very special. 
My friends mom spilled sauce on her white shirt and Gregoria was right there to witness and she immediately got her Club soda to get the stain out of her shirt which I thought was very very nice of her. 
overall very great experience and we will most definitely return!
Great food, service and ambiance.  Highlyrecommend for anyone visiting the city.  I will be a recurring customer.
It's alright, my kids crave it but always get a stomach ache. Not sure why though. For decent ramen this is the ace to go on the east coast
Don't know how to cook a steak rare. Rare means red or pink, not gray. Steak was burnt to a crisp because their cooks are cooks. Waste of money.

Solid stop in the city for a drink if you're walking around and need a place to have a bite and a sip. We were there at an off hour (3pm or so?) so it was neither lunch nor happy hour. I think they were changing shifts, and the service was a little lackluster and our drinks for a party of 10 took quite a while to arrive (and many orders were just tap beer). I we sampled some of the apps (wings, mac and cheese) and I thought the food was fine, but nothing to rush back for. Overall, if you're looking for a casual chill vibe and standard bar food, this is your place.
Great food. Great service and great atmosphere! The eggplant tower appetizer was delicious! The back patio/bar area is really cool.
Restaurant was completely empty and it still took the workers about 5 minutes to even say Hello to me. Workers were not friendly at all. The pizza was good though. Just disappointing service.

We had sandwiches from baggies on a corporate trip to Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Tucson, AZ. I thought it was a good sandwich. It had many different selections of different sandwiches. I had the unforgettable. I would probably have picked a different sandwich had I known the 12 grain bread had tasted so dry. All in all, the restaurant had a lot of potential and I think I could have found a better sandwich to eat had I not ordered through our office menu. I would recommend that you try this restaurant and see how you like it for yourself.

I would definitely avoid this Longhorn in the future. We arrived and there were several empty tables throughout the restaurant.  We were told it would be a 30 minute wait for 6 of us.  It may have been because of lack of staff. The floors were covered with pieces of trash and were dirty. The bathroom was out of paper towels. Several people waiting ended up giving back their pager devices and leaving. While waiting, the lady at the desk snapped at my 3 year old who accidentally walked in her way. Our waiter was very friendly, but was definitely unorganized or overworked.  This was the second restaurant in this area that we've experienced in this way. Maybe it's the area. Maybe it's our luck. We aren't from around here, so I'm not sure.

We've been to this new location quite a few times since they've opened, both as carry out customers and eat-in. The food is great and we have never had an issue with service. They've been busy during the quarantine, but our carry out orders have always been ready on time and piping hot and fresh. 
The pizzas are fun and creative. Our favorites are the Veg Head and the Twice Baked. We also love their calzones and pasta dishes. You really can't go wrong! We love having a Puccini's so close to home and look forward to eating in again soon when this quarantine mess is over.

Tonight I ordered dinner for my team. We had Salmon, a filet and pasta. Overall dinner was delicious even though it was delivery. It came 10 minutes ahead of schedule which was also great. The food quality was great and I will do this option again. The only sad thing was we got 3 mashed potatoes instead of 1 and none of the green beans we ordered. That was a whole lot of mashed potatoes. Still great overall!

Best new spot in Northeast Philly, with that South Philly, traditional touch we Italians love and look forward too! You can come here with a large group, or even alone (chefs counter seating available). They don't typically take reservations for parties of 10 or less, and there is sometimes a wait but it is definitely worth it! Oh, and don't forget to bring something to drink, its BYOB! Say hi to Carmela herself, what a sweetheart! 

For starters I always get the wings, the sauce is spicy and sweet, but not your typical buffalo style. It is unique and delicious! Unlike anything I've ever experienced before and I can say the same for the gorgonzola dipping dressing! The burrata (Caprese) salad is also AMAZING, the arugula and tomatoes topped with balsamic make for a perfect starter dish and it is totally shareable. In fact, If you're dining with someone, I'd recommend getting a few different things and sharing it all! There's just too many things to try, everything is good! 

Because I am GF, I have not been able to personally try the pizza (they do not yet offer this on their menu) but i've seen it, and I've smelled it and I've heard the table get very quiet for a while :) 

They do offer GF pasta, my favorite being the Blush or My Nini. The quality of GF pasta is very good and I couldn't tell the difference! For all of their pasta dishes you can choose between different sauces and what type of noodle you'd like, which is super cool. (Full disclosure there is only one type of
Very good! First experience and I have to say I'm impressed. Came in for breakfast at 2:30 even though they wasn't serving breakfast (reason for 4 stars) and it's morning . Ended up getting a Poboy.

Fish was under cooked, fries were stale but the waitress was super nice 
My dad enjoyed his steak and chicken Madeira, said it was excellent.
Tex mex roll & potato soup was good as well

What a wonderful, authentic restaurant. Not only is the food delicious but the staff is absolutely wonderful too. Every time we've ordered from here the food has been amazing and flavorful (even the rice and beans are seasoned well). Will definitely keep ordering from here!
We had BBQ shrimp n grits, pralines and bacon pancakes, and banana foster French toast. Everything was delicious.

We loved coming here for brunch before Covid and we cannot wait to return once we are post-pandemic. Everything is REALLY delicious--from the more simple to the more decadent! Chef Vargas is also very friendly and attentive to his customers, and especially good with our little wild ones.

I walked into this establishment and witnessed at least two people working without face coverings, one of whom I think was the owner. One would think that with the pandemic so out of control even the President tested positive for it, people would start to take the pandemic seriously. But not this establishment.

brisket is tender but dry as hell, barely got any smoke flavor, almost like it was braised in liquid, tastes kinda plain but the quality of brisket is not the worst. Mac and cheese wack, tastes very weird and artificial.

Honestly, Saigon is one of my favorite restaurants in the city. We have enjoyed eating at their establishment for many years, since way back when they were in a weird strip mall off 29th St, and before anyone in Indianapolis had ever heard of Pho or Bahn Mi. They should be an Indy standard if you are visiting the city and want great food.

Even though we are typically a carry-out household, when we go to Saigon we always eat in the restaurant. Their location in the former Bob Evans is open and airy, and appealing with a modern feel. When you walk in you can see the restaurant staff working and Peter is always there to greet you with a smile. We always wait to be seated, and he remembered our names long before we remembered his. In fact, we have moved quite a bit farther away, and can't visit as often, but he always remembers our names, and pretty much knows what we are going to order, too.

We have had several dishes over the years, but since we can't attend as often, we usually stick to our favorites these days. My must haves are the Vietnamese Salad and the Duck, Mushroom, and Herbs soup (I get rice noodles instead of egg noodles). The duck soup is rich and savory. The salad is crunchy and bright. My husband prefers to order the Pho with beef, which has a layered slightly sour and herbal broth. To drink I often enjoy either the Jasmine Bubble Tea (a milky floral shake) or the Iced Vietnamese Coffee, which brews at your table.

I came in for a breakfast of Red  Menudo
About ten days ago and had a side tamale with mole'   
It was so good , I crossed town tonight so I could make Tamales and Eggs for dinner. 

A dozen tamales , 20.00. Fair. None frozen. 
And a sign says, CASH only for tamales only.  Good thing I had cash. 
Made a great dinner, worth the effort. 

Update 
Called for take out tamales. Recording says thanks but closed. 
Update May 27 2020

There are open again for curb service and maybe limited dining. I picked up a dozen beef tamales and dark mole sauce for the  tops. Dinner tonight with black beans n eggs. 
The booths are tagged open and closed so I am guessing you can go in.  I arrived at ten am as the door opened.  She was glad to see me. I called ahead 30 minutes to make sure they made beef this morning. 
Dinner will be great!

The food was oh so delicious and the portions were huge.... first time in for brunch and I was not disappointed.  I went with the chicken and waffles.  The seasoning was perfection...  (I have had lunch there as well and that was delicious as well)

Todays visit just reinforced why I hate eating out. If its not 1 thing, its another. So Im in a great mood, ready to enjoy a treat & this girl comes over. She says what can i get ya. I say cheese steak & fries, she walks away, I say I want provolone, as shes walking away. I should have left then. I really pisses me off when the waitress (who is working for tips) has a lousy attitude.

Guess how much tip she got?

 0! 

ps the cheesesteak was good

My husband treated me for my birthday. This restaurant is definitely hood for special occasion. The ambiance, service and food, everything was very good. We will come back for another special occasion for sure!

First off, they definitely need 10 stars for this place! I am a foodie, this pizza is the best I've ever had. I must say I haven't had a slice in Italy but I'm pretty certain that the buffalo chicken pizza at this spot tops it!

Very good Mexican food find. The restaurant itself is very small, so if you have a big party, you might want to go when it's not busy or order out. They have about 5-6 tables inside and then some outdoor seating. The food is very fresh tasting and not at all greasy. The chicken tacos are flavorful, especially with the salsa verde and lime. The street corn is very creamy and a good contrast to the spicy salsas. The chips and salsa are THE BEST chips and salsa I've ever had in STL. The salsa is so fresh and light, I could eat is by the gallon. I like the enchiladas; they come with a side of cilantro rice and baked beans which were a delicious combo with the cheesy enchiladas (which were also not greasy). Finally, the Cadillac margaritas are amazing. Overall, would recommend a try!

What to say about Sukho Thai... it's decent food and decent drinks. The space is huge and spacious for Magazine St.

Our waiter was also the bartender? Well, either way, he made our cocktails and was super friendly and helpful. 

My friend and I shared a few plates...we had the pineapple shrimp fried rice, shrimp pad thai, and peppery garlic chicken. You can choose your level of spiciness and your meal is served with an array of different dipping sauces with varying spice levels. I enjoyed all of the food and would definitely come back.

Also came during happy hour and ordered a few different drinks. Overall, would come back. Service and food was good!
We waited at our table for 15-20 minutes and never received any service. After asking several waiters about our waiter we were rudely ignored.

My first and last visit here. For starters, it was probably close to 85 degrees in the dining room, and the table was so sticky the paper menu stuck and tore as I tried to pick it up. I would have walked out had we not been meeting friends for our first "dine in" meal together since the shutdown. 

Our group gave the food mixed reviews from pretty good to pretty bad. One friend had the burger with candied bacon. This is a medium well guy, but his patty was so overdone and dry he could barely swallow it. Three of us chose a supposedly house-smoked turkey sandwich. Not even a hint of smokiness. I ordered mine with the red pepper sauce, and it was OK, but the tablespoon size portion was not enough to add flavor. I chose a mild cheese. All was smashed together on two pieces of dry toast. Absolutely no flavor. To make it worse, the menu stated that one sauce and one cheese of choice accompanied the sandwich. I was charged extra for the cheese. My wife had their "Cuban" which she rated pretty good. The Steak & Shake shoestring fries were decent, but the ketchup was the highlight of the meal.

Don't break your Covid fast at this place!

Best BBQ with local suppliers. Friendly owner. Space is open and clean. If you're looking to support local business this is the SPOT. Everything is so tasty and so fresh. Can't go wrong with anything on their menu. Going to brush fire after this place would be criminal.

Super convenient for Chinese food not in Chinatown! 

Beef Lo Mein was delicious. Not super salty like most take out restaurants. I also enjoyed the Sichuan spicy beef noodle soup. They separate the soup and noodles for take out. The noodles are thick which I prefer. The soup was on the oily side. I also tried the dry pot style chicken. Chicken was tender and the flavor was yummy.  That dish was my favorite!

The hostess didn't see us and then when we pointed ourselves out to us she was not friendly. Took food 40 minutes to arrive - two tables ordered and got food before we got ours at 1pm on a Friday afternoon. Many empty tables. My salad which I requested no bacon on came with bacon. We had two waiters who did not check that everything was okay so we had to get up and find one of them to tell them. They did replace it and then not charge us but not until after I had a bite of bacon as a lifelong vegetarian. Hominy dish was room temp but supposed to be hot. Food was all fine but not amazing. Would not come back.

We had an excellent dinner experience at Bianco this evening. My colleagues and I had the calamari & antipasto for first course; the antipasto was extraordinary (especially the homemade ricotta cheese). For the dinner course, we had the rigatoni with spicy Italian sausage, which was also outstanding! I would definitely plan on coming back to Bianco.
this place is cute and has the most delicious waffles i've ever tasted! the smoothies and amazing too (i recommend the miami vice, it's amazing).

$14.99 is kinda overpriced for cold, dry, and overcooked chicken with cold chewy waffles. Bonus, you prepay AND tip when you order...then fill and refill your own drinks and clean your own table. So much for Joella's HOT Chicken...

This review is based solely on going to Schlafly for beer tasting only and nothing to do with ordering food. Although, I have been there with friends who ordered food and they didn't say anything negative and it looked like it met their expectations. 

I really enjoy going to Schlafly for a couple beers with my friends.  I've really enjoyed going sitting outside on either the picnic tables (which are for people their just to drink a few brews) or under the outdoor/open air structure (which you have to order food). That's probably my biggest callout about going here: picnic tables can be full and if you want to have a couple beers outside, you may have to wait or order food. It can be confusing because open seats can be available but like I said, gotta order food. I get it though, that's what makes the $$$. 

Beer selection is pretty fantastic and I appreciate that as Schlafly has continued to grow, they have continued to do some experimental/different stuff. I've especially enjoyed their coconut cream ale lately. 

Finally, I've never felt rushed to get up or out and the service has always been good. 

Tips: they have water and cups outside by the picnic tables during the summer and they are dog friendly at the picnic tables

I don't go out for ice cream very often, but when I do, I like to support local businesses over the big franchised chains.  So, while in Avon, I made a point to stop at this place to give it a try.

Although they have convenient drive thru, I parked in the horse shoe parking lot that surrounds the building and walked up to the order counter.  Overhead, there are menus for a few meal items as well as the large list of flavors for the ice creams available.  You place your order and pay at the window on the right and pick up your order at the left window.

I decided to go with a sundae (strawberry) over an ice cream cone or frozen custard cone.  I saw the listings for waffle cones, but didn't see any pricing for getting a scoop in a bowl which is what I have been doing lately.  So, the frozen custard sundae was soon ready with plenty of yummy strawberry/sauce topped with whipped cream and Maraschino cherry.  Although provided with a plastic spoon and napkins, I must say the spoon was very flimsy and bent a little even with the soft serve custard.  I wonder if it would have held up with the firmer ice cream selections.

Anyway, the flavor was quite good and the price was reasonable.  Service was friendly and pretty swift.  I enjoyed my sundae and was soon back on the road.

Review #2521

I have been to the prep and pasty on Campbell since the shut down and their food was excellent! I also tried
one of the scones and that was also really good!. I'm so glad I decided to try out this place again. 

I don't know what happened to this place but ever since they moved to a bigger location and expanded to more locations the quality has gone down hill. It's really disappointing because this used to my favorite breakfast place in Tucson. They used to have the best French toast that used to change every month. It was like a cake based french toast it was the best and unique to anywhere else. Now the French toast is just tasteless bread that taste more like overpriced frozen French toast sprinkled with cinnamon and given a fancy name to make it sound special, "churro French toast". The potatoes also used to be the best that were baked with rosemary but now are just deep fried potatoes. It's really disappointing..
Always a busy place, great service and great food.  My go-to spot when visiting New Orleans
I had Nevada's best patty melt and chips here for lunch. Absolutely charming building and the staff were delightful. I would highly recommend this establishment.

Warning:  the following contains some digressions into personal and local history.  Read at your own risk... Nothing to do on an early-waking morning when I couldn't sleep... so I might as well write a yelp review of the most successful independent Chinese restaurant in Boise.  My personal history with YC extends back into my boyhood in the 80s.  The Chinese community was small and my mom was able to get me a bus boy job that lasted 1 night because I sucked.  Later, when it was her birthday or Mother's Day she would always want Chinese food and yen Ching was usually her choice.  I remember the jiaozi on the buffet was dried out when we took her there for Mother's Day but to be fair that was probably in 1990.  Nowadays, YC basically provides some of the only true legit Chinese food I've eaten here, even though they still do the good old Chinese American stuff like sesame chicken and Mongolian beef.  And admittedly they do it all passably well.  The defining stamp of legitimacy is that they actually do serve chicken feet-- something I ate more than once when I lived in China in 2000.  Honestly I was never sure if chicken feet were an actual usual dish for Chinese people or if they were just offloading them on us unsuspecting waiguoren (foreigners), but I do think it was the former.  BTW I am Americanized enough to say that there is little redeeming value to chicken feet, so there's no need to order them.  I did it in the spring of 2019 and made my kids try it in preparation for

I wasn't going to even say anything - but I feel compelled after that taco. The ensenada...soooo beautifully fried. The homemade tortilla was perfect. And I actually ate it without taking a picture first, so you know it's bomb. Plus that fresh tomato salsa/hot sauce is so different and delicious. 

Thanks for the recommendation (to the sweet woman who answered the phone on Monday the 29th.) mil mil gracias

One of the best seafood restaurants in town.  Peche offers some of the best gulf fish in New Orleans.  The interior offers a nice spot for date night.  I got the smoked tuna dip which was fresh.  For the main course, the lamb skewers were tender and tuna was cooked to perfection.  I wish I got more tuna for the price.  For dessert, they had a red velvet ice cream special that was great.  Peche is up on the GW Fins level as far as the top seafood restaurants in New Orleans.

I've heard mixed reviews about this place from peers but I happened to really enjoy everything I ordered here! My friend and I split a pitcher of the rose sangria, so good!! A pitcher was worth the value, we each got 3 glasses from it. We also shared "The perfect leave" appetizer. Which was shaved beef tenderloin on a crostini with goat cheese and a horseradish sour cream. It was very good!! Small but tasty.

I had a spicy salmon roll, which was ok and also The Godfather flatbread- this flatbread was amazing!! Spicy shrimp, loaded with Portobello mushrooms, a pesto fondue base with Asiago and mozzarella. So freaking good!! My friend had the margarita flatbread and liked it. Mine was better haha. I would definitely come back here again.

I placed an order Wednesday night (5/15). I have to say we were not impressed at all.  The tails were soggy and barely warm.  Ordered a large side of hot sauce, it was ice cold and had clumps of seasoning in it.  Turkey wrap was soggy.  Was told by the girl on the phone they didn't have celery but could give us carrots and blue cheese instead.  We were given a bunch of baby carrots with 3 containers of caesar dressing, no blue cheese.  Next time I will drive to the 206 location!

We used to LOVE this restaurant but the quality has gone way downhill. Not sure if it's because they're busy opening their second restaurant but  it's a big mistake if they can't even get this one right. We ordered the mushroom flatbread which was boring and bland. A family member had the ribs and they were underwhelming, lacking flavor and tenderness. The coleslaw that came with the fried chicken was literally just mayonnaise and cabbage- what happened to the seasoning/vinegar? Our fried chicken looked nothing like the fried chicken that the table next to us ordered and it was the exact same thing. The atmosphere is cold and the portions have gone down in size. Please fix this! You used to be so good.

The gem of a local watering hole has a lot of character.  Great staff and service while I was at lunch yesterday.  I had a Cuban that was cooked to perfection and maybe one of the best I've ever had.  For $11 it was a ton of food and hit the spot.  I'm stoked I had a killer new lunch spot on my list.  Great job Galley crew

Honey Walnut Shrimp with Combination - Chicken, Pork, Beef & Shrimp Fried rice. Legit homies!  I came here twice, during my visit and the food was good both times, service was lacking the second visit so they are at 50/50 with me. Served family style but the prices are fair. They also set you up with some complimentary tea, upon being seated.  If you want to peruse the menu, check it out here. http://orderemeirestaurant.com/ 

I would give this place a try if you are in the area. You won't be disappointed.

AMAZING service! The rice and beans were PUT OF THIS WORLD! I had the grilled Gruyere, Avocado and bacon sandwich and my brother had the West Tampa. Both were dynamite!! Can't say enough about this cute little sandwich shop. Nice work!

I had a large to go order and he gave me everything organized and accounted for and also gave me a crate to carry everything in! Everything was fresh and delicious per usual thanks again the customer service was excellent!!

We used to really like this place, we have lived down the street for over 20 years, we even had our oldest sons birthday party there many years ago. Lately quality and care seems way down. If you like your salad cold do not order from them! They will put it on top of the pizza every time it comes steaming hot and the dressing is almost boiling. Even if you mention this and request they don't,  they still will. The last pizza I ordered tasted like it was cooked on a pre-made pizza shell that was stale, or cooked in a dirty oven. They had a pasta dish I loved made with their own cheese filled pasta, the last time I ordered it it tasted like it was made with dirty mushrooms that weren't even washed first. The entire dish tasted like dirt and mushrooms! It's sad this place is going down hill.

We ate at Ming's.yesterday. 

As always the service was excellent 
Staff attentive , delicious food and immaculate restaurant. 
It's also located nearby and in the heart of hatboro shops.
We also appreciate the lunch menu as we watch our budget.
i don't care what any bad reviews say. i fuck with chicken nuevo forever. 10/10 aint nothing better take my money
Best Chargrilled Oyster !!!! We came to this place just to try the oyster  when we are in a vacation from NJ ..loved it and can't wait to comeback again !!!

Spent my daughters 21st Bday here. If you want the best steak in Nashville, possibly the best steak on the planet, this is your place. 

Eaten at a ton of steak houses across the nation, this is def my top 2.

Waygu Ribeye was off the chart, wagyu filet for all the ladies was perfection.

I'm gonna say this might be the top 3 steakhouses. Mark, our server, was a consumate host that topped the evening off. 

We'll be back. Thank you for a great experience!
